name: verify_identity
description: Verify customer identity against an active session challenge (passcode, KBA, or OTP). An OTP on an already verified session is the step-up that contact-detail changes require.

challenge_response.description: The response provided by the customer for the challenge

session_id.description: The active session identifier, e.g. SESS01

customer_id.description: The unique customer identifier, e.g. C01

challenge_type.description: The type of identity challenge used

name: list_owned_cards
description: List payment cards owned by a verified customer, optionally filtered by status.

customer_id.description: The unique customer identifier, e.g. C01

status.description: Optional filter for card status ('active' or 'locked')

session_id.description: The active session identifier, e.g. SESS01

name: list_transactions
description: List transaction history for a verified customer, filterable by card_id, status (posted/pending), and limit.

customer_id.description: The unique customer identifier, e.g. C01

limit.description: Optional maximum number of transactions to return

card_id.description: Optional card identifier to filter transactions

session_id.description: The active session identifier, e.g. SESS01

name: get_dispute_policy
description: The bank's policy in effect for a topic, with the policy library document and version it comes from: transaction_dispute (window, eligible statuses, reasons), card_policy (lock, replacement, controls), fee_schedule, provisional_credit, contact_changes.

source.description: The approved policy document in effect: file_id, title, version, effective_date

name: lock_card
description: Lock or freeze a lost or compromised payment card with confirmation.

card_id.description: The card identifier to lock, e.g. CARD01

customer_id.description: The unique customer identifier, e.g. C01

session_id.description: The active session identifier, e.g. SESS01

reason.description: The reason for locking the card

confirmed.description: Whether the customer explicitly confirmed the card lock request

name: create_dispute
description: File a new transaction dispute for an eligible posted transaction, with idempotency protection.

transaction_id.description: The transaction identifier to dispute, e.g. TX17

request_key.description: Optional idempotency request key to avoid duplicate submissions

session_id.description: The active session identifier, e.g. SESS01

customer_notes.description: Optional customer details or explanation of the dispute

customer_id.description: The unique customer identifier, e.g. C01

name: get_dispute_status
description: Look up the current status and details of an existing dispute by dispute_id or transaction_id.

session_id.description: The active session identifier, e.g. SESS01

transaction_id.description: The transaction identifier to look up dispute for

customer_id.description: The unique customer identifier, e.g. C01

dispute_id.description: The dispute identifier to look up, e.g. D01

name: create_handoff
description: Create a specialist escalation or support handoff when automation is blocked or verification fails.

context.description: Context or notes explaining the handoff reason

reason.description: The reason triggering the escalation or handoff

transaction_id.description: Optional transaction identifier related to the handoff

card_id.description: Optional card identifier related to the handoff

customer_id.description: The unique customer identifier, e.g. C01

session_id.description: The active session identifier, e.g. SESS01

name: get_customer_profile
description: The verified customer's profile on file: name, email, phone, postal address, customer since, and whether this session has passed step-up verification.

customer_id.description: The verified customer's identifier, e.g. C01

session_id.description: The active session identifier, e.g. SESS01

name: list_accounts
description: The verified customer's accounts with masked numbers, type, balance (minor units) and status.

customer_id.description: The verified customer's identifier, e.g. C01

session_id.description: The active session identifier, e.g. SESS01

name: get_transaction
description: One transaction of the verified customer in full: merchant, the statement descriptor as it appears on the statement, amount, status, card, and any dispute already filed on it.

customer_id.description: The verified customer's identifier, e.g. C01

session_id.description: The active session identifier, e.g. SESS01

name: lookup_merchant_descriptor
description: Explain a statement descriptor (the merchant text on a statement, such as TGT*1042 MINNEAPOLIS MN): the merchant behind it, its category and location. Pass the descriptor text, or a transaction_id with the verified customer's session to look up that transaction's descriptor.

descriptor.description: The statement descriptor text exactly as the customer reads it

transaction_id.description: A transaction whose descriptor to explain (needs customer_id and session_id)

customer_id.description: The verified customer's identifier when transaction_id is given

session_id.description: The active session when transaction_id is given

name: request_replacement_card
description: Request a replacement for the verified customer's card after they confirmed the card and the delivery option. A lost or stolen card must be locked first; damaged, expired or never-received cards need no lock. Standard delivery is free (5-7 business days); expedited delivery (2 business days) carries the fee in the fee schedule. A repeated request_key returns the existing request.

customer_id.description: The verified customer's identifier, e.g. C01

session_id.description: The active session identifier, e.g. SESS01

card_id.description: The card to replace, e.g. CARD01

delivery_speed.description: standard (free, 5-7 business days) or expedited (fee, 2 business days)

confirmed.description: True only after the customer confirmed the card and the delivery option

request_key.description: Idempotency key for this request, e.g. REQ-C01-CARD01-RPL

name: update_card_controls
description: Change the verified customer's card controls on an active card after they confirmed: international use, online use, contactless, and the daily spending limit (minor units, up to the policy maximum). Controls cannot be changed on a locked card.

customer_id.description: The verified customer's identifier, e.g. C01

session_id.description: The active session identifier, e.g. SESS01

card_id.description: The card whose controls change, e.g. CARD01

international_enabled.description: Allow transactions outside the home country

daily_limit.description: Daily spending limit in minor units (cents), e.g. 300000 for $3,000.00

confirmed.description: True only after the customer confirmed the exact changes

name: list_disputes
description: The verified customer's disputes, optionally filtered by status (open, under_review, resolved, withdrawn).

customer_id.description: The verified customer's identifier, e.g. C01

session_id.description: The active session identifier, e.g. SESS01

name: withdraw_dispute
description: Withdraw one of the verified customer's open or under-review disputes after they confirmed; the charge then stands. Resolved disputes cannot be withdrawn.

customer_id.description: The verified customer's identifier, e.g. C01

session_id.description: The active session identifier, e.g. SESS01

dispute_id.description: The dispute to withdraw, e.g. D02

reason.description: Why the customer withdraws it, in their words

confirmed.description: True only after the customer confirmed the withdrawal and its consequence

name: update_contact_details
description: Change the verified customer's phone, email or postal address. Requires step-up: the session must also have passed a one-time passcode (otp) challenge with verify_identity. Requests by relatives or by email alone are not actioned. A repeated request_key returns the existing change.

customer_id.description: The verified customer's identifier, e.g. C01

session_id.description: The active session identifier, e.g. SESS01

new_value.description: The new value, exactly as confirmed with the customer

request_key.description: Idempotency key for this change, e.g. REQ-C05-ADDR-1

name: search_files
description: Search for Drive files using a structured query (syntax: `query_term operator values`). Clauses are joined with `and`; string values are single-quoted. Terms: title (contains, =, !=), fullText (contains), mimeType (contains, =, !=), parentId (=, !=), owner (=, !=; 'me' is the requesting user). Use nextPageToken to paginate.

pageToken.description: The page token to use for pagination.

pageSize.description: The maximum number of files to return in each page.

excludeContentSnippets.description: If true, the content snippet will be excluded from the response.

name: list_recent_files
description: Find recent files for the user in a sort order: recency (default), lastModified or lastModifiedByMe. The default page size is 10; use nextPageToken to paginate.

orderBy.description: The sort order for the files.

pageToken.description: The page token to use for pagination.

pageSize.description: The maximum number of files to return in each page.

excludeContentSnippets.description: If true, the content snippet will be excluded from the response.

name: get_file_metadata
description: General metadata about a Drive file. The description carries the policy family, status, version and effective date.

fileId.description: The ID of the file to retrieve.

excludeContentSnippets.description: If true, the content snippet will be excluded from the response.

name: get_file_permissions
description: List the permissions of a Drive file (its own and its folder's).

fileId.description: The ID of the file to get permissions for.

name: read_file_content
description: Fetch a natural language representation of a Drive file, and optionally its comments. fileId must come from search_files or list_recent_files. An unsupported format returns textFormattingNotSupported=true with empty fileContent. revisionId reads an earlier revision of the file.

fileId.description: The ID of the file to retrieve.

includeComments.description: Whether to include comments in the response.

revisionId.description: An earlier revision of the file to read instead of the current content.

name: search_threads
description: Lists email threads matching a Gmail search query (label:ID, is:unread, in:inbox, from:, to:, subject:, newer_than:7d, free terms). Full message bodies are not returned; use get_thread for them. Drafts, spam and trash are excluded.

name: get_thread
description: Retrieves an email thread by ID with its messages in date order (bodies under FULL_CONTENT).

threadId.description: The unique identifier of the thread.

messageFormat.description: MESSAGE_FORMAT_UNSPECIFIED, MINIMAL, FULL_CONTENT (default; bodies included) or METADATA_ONLY.

name: get_message
description: Retrieves one email message by its message ID.

messageId.description: The unique identifier of the message.

messageFormat.description: MESSAGE_FORMAT_UNSPECIFIED, MINIMAL, FULL_CONTENT (default; bodies included) or METADATA_ONLY.

name: list_labels
description: Lists the user-defined labels of the mailbox with their IDs. System label IDs (INBOX, UNREAD, STARRED, IMPORTANT, SENT, DRAFT, SPAM, TRASH) are usable without listing.

name: label_thread
description: Adds labels to an entire thread (every message in it). Takes label IDs, not names; use list_labels when unsure of a user label's ID.

threadId.description: The unique identifier of the thread.

labelIds.description: Label IDs (system IDs such as INBOX, UNREAD, IMPORTANT, or user label IDs from list_labels), never names.

name: unlabel_thread
description: Removes labels from an entire thread. Takes label IDs, not names.

threadId.description: The unique identifier of the thread.

labelIds.description: Label IDs (system IDs such as INBOX, UNREAD, IMPORTANT, or user label IDs from list_labels), never names.

name: list_drafts
description: Lists the mailbox's drafts, newest first. humanEdited marks a draft a person has edited.

name: create_draft
description: Creates a draft email for a person to review and send. To reply in an existing thread pass the original message's ID as replyToMessageId. Addresses are plain (no 'Name <email>'). Attachments are not supported yet. Nothing is sent.

replyToMessageId.description: The message this draft replies to; the draft joins its thread.
